meta.title: Las Vegas Hotels — Official First-Party Booking Engine Verification (Feb 15 – Mar 23, 2027)
meta.lodging_tax_proof: Confirmed directly on Caesars official room-list policy block: $54.95 resort fee + $7.35 tax = $62.30 ($7.35 / $54.95 = 13.3758%, standard 13.38% Clark County Strip hotel room tax); Resorts World itemised checkout ($51.52 resort-fee tax / $385.00 resort fees = 13.3818%). Downtown Las Vegas city jurisdiction is ~13.0–13.38%; where an engine does not print checkout tax separately, 13.38% is applied and explicitly labelled 'est. w/ 13.38% tax'.
meta.room_rule: Every priced row is a NAMED room guaranteeing >= 1 Queen bed (1 Queen, 2 Queens, or 1 King) AND a private en-suite bathroom. Cheaper 'Room Type Assigned on Arrival' (bed not guaranteed) and '2 Doubles' rooms are explicitly rejected and recorded only as comparison notes.
meta.transit_rule: Public transit counts distinguish: (a) in-building / <=10 min walk, (b) <=35 min estimated door-to-door via public RTC Bus (Deuce + Route 203) or Las Vegas Monorail, and (c) <=60 min estimated door-to-door via public RTC Bus / Monorail. All transit minute figures are ESTIMATES from official station maps and the RTC Route 203 PDF timetable — never official door-to-door guarantees. Vegas Loop is noted separately as a point-to-point tunnel EV system, not public bus/subway.
meta.booking_window_finding: Nov 27 – Dec 4, 2026 (Cyber Monday / Black Friday week) is empirically the strongest upcoming booking window: Fontainebleau Bleau Friday waives the $55+$7.35/night resort fee for free Rewards members + adds a $350 dining credit if booked by Dec 2, 2026; Wynn & Encore Cyber Exclusive saves up to 20% + $300 resort credit if booked Nov 20 – Dec 4, 2026 (72h free cancellation); Caesars Cyber Monday Early Access + 15% new-member Rewards discount and Resorts World / Downtown Grand Black Friday promos are live on 2026-11-27 with 48h–72h free cancellation on refundable tiers.
